        ..., description="Path to input H5 file", cli=("-f", "--hdf5")
    )", "replace": "    input_file3: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Path to input H5 file",
        json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-f", "--hdf5")},
    )", "explanation": "The failure is raised by `Field(..., cli=...)`. In Pydantic V2, extra keyword arguments on `Field` are deprecated (PydanticDeprecatedSince20). Per the V2 migration guide, custom metadata must go in `json_schema_extra`. The value is kept identical so the CLI flags are unchanged."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_boolean_custom.py:55:optional-no-default"], "search": "        description="Enable beta filter mode",
        cli=("-b", "--beta-filter"),", "replace": "        description="Enable beta filter mode",
        json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-b", "--beta-filter")},", "explanation": "Same deprecated `Field` extra kwarg `cli=` on `beta_filter`. It is moved into `json_schema_extra` as the V2 migration guide requires. This is the same deprecation that would fire next after `input_file3`."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_boolean_custom.py:55:optional-no-default"], "search": "        description="Enable epsilon meta-analysis.",
        cli=("--epsilon", "--disable-epsilon"),", "replace": "        description="Enable epsilon meta-analysis.",
        json_schema_extra={"cli": ("--epsilon", "--disable-epsilon")},", "explanation": "Same deprecated `cli=` extra kwarg on `epsilon` `Field`. It is moved into `json_schema_extra` per the V2 migration guide. It must be fixed too, or the module will still fail at import."}], "notes": "Changes are limited to the three `Field(..., cli=...)` calls. Those calls are the only remaining cause of the import-time PydanticDeprecatedSince20 error. The first failing one was input_file3, and beta_filter and epsilon fail the same way once it is fixed.

No edit was needed for the other findings:
- pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_boolean_custom.py:20:config-class: the current file already uses `model_config = ConfigDict(**{...})`. There is no `class Config` left, so this is already migrated.
- pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_boolean_custom.py:38 (outfile) and :55 (gamma): `outfile: Optional[str] = None` and `gamma: Optional[bool] = None` already have explicit `= None` defaults, which keeps v1 behavior.

The code in pydantic_cli/core.py (also being migrated) must read the flags from `field.json_schema_extra["cli"]` instead of `field.field_info.extra["cli"]`. Otherwise the CLI flags will be lost. Note that json_schema_extra also ends up in the generated JSON schema, and tuples are serialized as lists there. No new imports are needed."}
